Select exact IC50 activity measurements in nM for compounds tested against human Bromodomain-containing protein 4. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs to resolve pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter by target name 'Bromodomain-containing protein 4' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and restrict to standard_type 'IC50' with standard_units 'nM' and standard_relation '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
